title: Unlocking collaborative data ecosystems with Catena-X
summary: The automotive industry is at a crossroads, facing challenges that demand collaboration, innovation and adaptability. Catena-X is a pioneering initiative redefining how companies share data and work together. With nearly 200 organizations already on board, including major manufacturers like BMW, Mercedes-Benz, and Volkswagen, Catena-X is rapidly gaining momentum and setting the standard for data ecosystems in the automotive sector and other industries as well.
